notes: This governs the ORDINARY ladder only ('read' < 'review' < 'write' < 'run'). High-risk capabilities (crystal_groom, freeze_unfreeze, ide_ingest, canonize, invariant_registry_mutate, protocol_ratify, standing_admin, access_admin) remain explicitly OUTSIDE this cascade -- resolveCapability's own module header already states 'HIGH-RISK CAPABILITIES ARE NEVER IMPLIED BY write/run', and this invariant does not weaken or reinterpret that.

'admin' is resolved via persona.cartridgeFlags.isAdmin upstream of this cascade, never via an access_grant_capabilities row -- the cascade is for the ordinary participation ladder available to non-admin grants only.

The Resource x Principal/Delegate x Capability -> Allowed Actions primitive (operator framing, 2026-09-12) is this cascade's governing shape: a single server-side function must be the one place 'what is the highest ordinary rung this principal holds at this resource' is computed, for human UI, MCP tools, and delegated agents alike.

canaries.assertion: resolveEffectiveExperimentCapability returns the highest of run/write/review with an active, unexpired, correctly-scoped capability row, falls back to 'read' with none, is resource-scoped (never leaks across experimentId), and never elevates on an expired row.

statement: Any surface (human UI, MCP tool, or delegated-agent resolver) that needs to know 'the highest ordinary capability rung a principal holds at one resource' must call one shared resolver (resolveEffectiveExperimentCapability, or its successor if the scope model generalizes beyond experiments) rather than re-deriving the read/review/write/run cascade inline at each call site -- exactly as resolveCapability itself is already the one function every human UI and MCP/agent surface must call for a single literal capability check.

occurrences.defect: No prior caller computed a cumulative ladder position -- every existing resolveCapability call site checked exactly one literal capability value, which is correct for a single mutation gate but left the Workspace projection (and any future UI/MCP parity) with no shared source of truth for which ordinary rung to render or report.
